# FDG5106

> DO NOT use Boolean parameters unless you are absolutely sure there will never be a need for more than two values.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.8.1 Choosing Between Enum and Boolean Parameters.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not checked: whether there will never be a need for more than two values is a prediction (the Abrams annotation). FDG5105 reports members with two or more Boolean parameters.

## From the book

Enums give you some room for future addition of values, but you should be aware of all the implications of adding values to enums, as described in section 4.8.2.

> **Brad Abrams:** We have seen a couple of places in the framework where we added a Boolean in one version, and in the next version we were forced to add another Boolean option to account for what could have been a foreseeable change. Don’t let this happen to you: If there is even a slight possibility of needing more options in the future, use an enum now.
